title: Dynamic Services subsidiary wins ₹5.48 lakh order from Banaras Locomotive Works Dynamic Services & Security Limited's subsidiary, The Bharat Battery Mfg Co Private Limited, received a ₹5.47 lakh work order from Banaras Locomotive Works Varanasi for supplying lead acid batteries. The delivery is scheduled from June 23, 2026, to July 8, 2026. The order is domestic and falls under standard Indian Railways terms

Ashirwad Steels & Industries Ltd FY26 net profit declines 12% 1 Ashirwad Steels & Industries Limited reported a 12% decline in net profit to ₹202.02 lakh for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, compared to ₹229.66 lakh in the previous year. Total income decreased to ₹416.34 lakh from ₹429.94 lakh, driven by a reduction in other income. The company’s total investments increased to ₹41.86 crore, while loans advanced stood at ₹16.55 crore

Tata Elxsi and Sky mark milestone in AI-led autonomous network transformation 4 Tata Elxsi and Sky have marked a milestone in their partnership to accelerate AI-led autonomous networks using the NEURON platform portfolio. The collaboration modernizes network provisioning and operations, resulting in up to 30% improved operational efficiency, 50% faster change lead times, and 60–70% cost efficiencies. Executives from both companies highlighted the platform's role in enhancing visibility, simplifying processes, and addressing industry challenges like legacy environments
